text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 100, "unit": "problems", "kind": "count", "span": "He has 100 math problems to complete"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 12, "unit": "problems", "kind": "count", "span": "He completes 12 problems on Monday night"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "On Tuesday, he completes 3 times as many problems as Monday"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 0.25, "unit": "", "kind": "rate", "span": "On Wednesday, he completes one-quarter of the remaining problems"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "Tuesday is 3 times Monday's 12"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "take Monday's work off the total"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s2", "s1"], "out": "s3", "note": "take Tuesday's work off as well"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s3", "q4"], "out": "s4", "note": "Wednesday is one-quarter of that remainder"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s3", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "what is left after Wednesday"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "how many problems are left to complete on Thursday"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 1, "reason": "the 1 of 'one-quarter' is part of the fraction 0.25, which is already used"}]}
